name: @tabhandoff/cli
description: TabHandoff CLI — Capture → Package → Continue. The open handoff protocol for AI agents.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --clean --external playwright && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/index.js';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!s.startsWith('#!'))s='#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+s;fs.writeFileSync(p,s);fs.chmodSync(p,0o755)"
